prerequisites: Recommended: knowledge of drawing at the Baccalaureate level.

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with basic knowledge of computer-aided design techniques.
Develop the ability to see or imagine geometric shapes in space and mentally perform operations with them.
Enable students to understand tasks, synthesize ideas, and identify with technical language as a means of communication.
Acquire proficiency in handling drawing instruments and sketching parts as a means to express graphic ideas quickly and accurately.
Students know and value standardization as a universal means of graphic language.
Ability for spatial vision and knowledge of graphic representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric geometry and descriptive geometry, and by computer-aided design applications.
Understand and know the fundamental principles governing geometric constructions.
Understand and know the fundamental principles governing representation systems to interpret and represent engineering drawings.
Be able to know and apply representation standards and incorporate the use of technical terms in the language.
Be able to know, understand and use computer-aided design programs to represent engineering drawings.
Be able to understand, know and use graphic visualization techniques to improve spatial vision linked to engineering.

assessment_rules: In the ordinary call, the final grade is calculated as 0.5 x ETP1 + 0.1 x PA + 0.2 x PL + 0.2 x TIG, provided a minimum of 5 out of 10 is obtained in the final exam (ETP1) and laboratory practices (PL). If these minimums are not met, the qualification will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, the final exam (ETP2) and a laboratory practices exam (EPL) are required, with a minimum of 5 out of 10 in both. The formula for extraordinary call is 0.5 x ETP2 + 0.1 x PA + 0.2 x EPL + 0.2 x TIG, otherwise the qualification will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For differentiated evaluation, the formulas are 0.7 x ETP1 + 0.3 x PL for ordinary and 0.7 x ETP2 + 0.3 x EPL for extraordinary, with the same minimums and conditional 4.0.
